source_type: SEC regulatory filing, official government crisis investigation report, bankruptcy examiner documents

tier_a: Lehman Brothers 10-Q SEC filing, June 2008 — contemporaneous financial disclosure
Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission final report (2011) — official government investigation
Anton R. Valukas bankruptcy examiner report — official court-appointed investigation of collapse
tier_b: Federal Reserve and Treasury contemporaneous statements on investment bank stress
Credible financial journalism covering Lehman's capital raise and market position in mid-2008
Academic analysis of investment bank leverage and liquidity during the 2008 crisis

contamination_notes: Examiner's report and FCIC report are post-mortem documents. September 2008 bankruptcy filing, Barclays asset purchase, final crisis aftermath, and examiner conclusions must not appear in input.json. Input must use only mid-2008 market and financial stress facts observable as of June 30, 2008.
source_limitations: FCIC report and bankruptcy examiner report are retrospective; used only for outcome and scoring
Examiner's conclusions on Repo 105 and asset overvaluation are post-decision and excluded from input
September 2008 collapse details are post-decision and must remain in outcome only
Barclays transaction is post-decision and excluded from input
Crisis aftermath and systemic effects are post-decision and excluded from input
